case_title: VICTOR SOTOMAYOR VS. STEPHANIE MICHELLE HANGER

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,495.41 FILED BY SOTOMAYOR, VICTOR AS TO DEFENDANT HANGER, STEPHANIE MICHELLE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-30-2017 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERVICE $ 60.00 SERVED JUL-20-2017, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT HANGER, STEPHANIE MICHELLE

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF AUG-30-2017 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF AUG-30-2017 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. PLAINITFF VICTOR SOTOMAYER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT STEPHANIE HANGER IS PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL; CLERK: J. MURPHY; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-30-2017 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SOTOMAYOR, VICTOR IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT HANGER, STEPHANIE MICHELLE THE PLAINTIFF FAILED TO MEET HIS BURDEN OF PROOF BY THE PREPONDERANCE OF THE EVIDENCE STANDARD THAT DEFENDANT'S NEGLIGENCE WAS A CAUSE OF PLAINTIFF'S DAMAGE LOSS OR HARM. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
